subject: Game Theory
title: The Winner's Curse
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Winner's Curse.

hook.text: You win an auction. Congratulations—you just paid more than everyone else thinks the item is worth.

buildup.text: When an item's value is uncertain, the most optimistic bidder wins. Optimism becomes a liability.

discovery.text: Oil companies bidding on drilling rights often overbid. The winner overpays because they overestimated.

twist.text: Smart bidders adjust downward: if I win, I probably overvalued. So I should bid less than my estimate.

climax.text: The winner's curse hits hardest when there are many bidders and high uncertainty about the prize.

punchline.text: Winning can be its own punishment.

quiz.question: When is the winner's curse most severe?
